sentences.en: He began to ______ over every small detail of the presentation.
sentences.zh: 他開始對簡報中的每一個小細節都感到困擾。

sentences.en: Fans continue to ______ over the mystery ending of the film.
sentences.zh: 影迷們仍持續對這部電影神秘的結局感到著迷。

sentences.en: A ______ lifestyle can increase the risk of heart disease.
sentences.zh: 久坐不動的生活方式會提高罹患心臟病的風險。

sentences.en: Many office workers lead a ______ life, sitting at a desk for eight hours a day.
sentences.zh: 許多上班族過著久坐的生活,每天坐在辦公桌前長達八小時。

sentences.en: Her ______ study habits helped her earn top marks in every subject.
sentences.zh: 她刻苦勤勉的學習習慣讓她在每一科都拿到最高分。

sentences.en: The ______ nurse checked on her patients every hour throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 這位盡職勤奮的護士整夜每小時都去查看她的病人。

sentences.en: The disease's ______ symptoms went unnoticed for years.
sentences.zh: 這種疾病潛伏隱匿的症狀多年來都未被察覺。

sentences.en: Corruption can spread through an organization in ______ ways.
sentences.zh: 貪腐可能會以陰險潛伏的方式蔓延整個組織。

words.defn_en: to or on one side; a remark not meant to be heard by everyone:

sentences.en: She pulled him ______ to discuss the matter privately.
sentences.zh: 她把他拉到一旁,私下討論這件事。

sentences.en: The actor's clever ______ drew laughter from the front rows.
sentences.zh: 演員機智的旁白引來前排觀眾的笑聲。

sentences.en: Teachers use quizzes to ______ students' understanding of the material.
sentences.zh: 老師利用小考來評估學生對教材的理解程度。

sentences.en: The insurance company sent an agent to ______ the damage to the house.
sentences.zh: 保險公司派了一名理賠專員來評估這棟房子的損害情況。

words.defn_en: an abnormal fear of traveling in underground trains or tunnels:
words.root_note: bathys (deep) + sideros (iron) + dromos (running) + phobos (fear), from Greek

sentences.en: His ______ made his daily subway commute an ordeal.
sentences.zh: 他的地下鐵恐懼症,讓每天搭地鐵通勤成了一種折磨。

sentences.en: Few people have heard of ______ , yet it affects many tunnel commuters.
sentences.zh: 很少人聽過地下鐵恐懼症這個詞,但它其實影響著許多搭乘地鐵通勤的人。

words.defn_en: in addition; furthermore; apart from or in addition to someone or something:
words.root_note: be- (by) + side; literally, by the side of

sentences.en: The proposal is too expensive; ______, it would take years to complete.
sentences.zh: 這項提案費用過高；此外，還需要數年才能完成。

sentences.en: No one ______ the lead researcher had access to the confidential laboratory records.
sentences.zh: 除了首席研究員之外，沒有人能查閱機密實驗室紀錄。

words.defn_en: careful thought about something; thoughtfulness toward others:

sentences.en: After much ______ , she decided to accept the job offer.
sentences.zh: 經過再三考量後,她決定接受這份工作邀約。

sentences.en: His ______ for his elderly neighbor never went unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 他對年邁鄰居的體貼,從未被人忽略。

words.defn_en: a person who opposes official policy, especially in an authoritarian state:
words.defn_zh: 異議人士;持不同政見的

sentences.en: The ______ was imprisoned for criticizing the regime.
sentences.zh: 這位異議人士因批評政權而遭到監禁。

sentences.en: Several ______ writers fled the country after the crackdown.
sentences.zh: 在這波鎮壓後,好幾位持不同政見的作家逃離了這個國家。

words.defn_en: to have or own something; to have as a quality:
words.root_note: possidere (to have and hold), from Latin potis (able) + sedere (to sit)

sentences.en: She began to ______ a rare talent for languages at a young age.
sentences.zh: 她從小就具備了學習語言的罕見天賦。

sentences.en: The family had come to ______ the estate for over a century.
sentences.zh: 這個家族已經擁有這座莊園超過一個世紀。

words.defn_en: to become less intense or violent; to sink to a lower level:
words.root_note: subsidere, from Latin sub- (down) + sidere (to settle)

sentences.en: The storm began to ______ after several hours.
sentences.zh: 這場暴風雨經過數小時後開始平息。

sentences.en: Her anger gradually began to ______ as she calmed down.
sentences.zh: 隨著她逐漸冷靜下來,她的怒氣也漸漸平息了。

words.defn_en: to take the place of, especially something outdated:
words.root_note: supersedere, from Latin super- (above) + sedere (to sit)

sentences.en: The new safety regulations will ______ the outdated guidelines.
sentences.zh: 這項新的安全規範將取代這套過時的準則。

sentences.en: Digital cameras eventually began to ______ traditional film cameras.
sentences.zh: 數位相機最終開始取代傳統的底片相機。
